svg.title: Marco Polo: Eurasian Silk Road and return waypoint map
svg.desc: Real Eurasian and Indian Ocean coastlines with selected stops from 1271 to 1295.
svg.metadata: Natural Earth v5.1.2, 1:50 million, public domain. Generated by scripts/build-geography.mjs. Boundaries follow the dataset's de facto policy and are not an endorsement of sovereignty claims.
svg.text: Marco Polo · overland Silk Road & maritime return (1271–1295)
Solid gold: 1271–1275 outbound overland · dashed cyan: 1291–1295 maritime return via Indian Ocean
Natural Earth 50m · equirectangular · approximate stop connections, not surveyed medieval routes
